character: Southern Alps resort in the Ubaye valley at the gates of Mercantour National Park. Linked to La Foux d'Allos for 180km Espace Lumière. Tour de France history (1975 — Merckx beaten here). Hosted 1999 Junior World Championships.
description: Pra-Loup is a southern Alps resort in the Ubaye valley, 7km from Barcelonnette. 2 base areas: Pra-Loup 1600 (primary) and Pra-Loup 1500/Les Molanès. Linked to La Foux d'Allos via the Agneliers valley to form 180km total. 39 runs (6 green, 13 blue, 17 red, 3 black), 53 lifts. 80% of terrain above 2,000m. Classified health resort since 1981. Hosted 1999 Junior World Alpine Ski Championships. Famous in cycling history — the 1975 Tour de France stage where Bernard Thévenet beat Eddy Merckx (the 'Merckx is beaten/Bastille has fallen' moment). Home of Fumeton — local cured mutton speciality.

non_ski_activities.mercantour_park: At the gates of Mercantour National Park — 9,000+ species, exceptional biodiversity. Guided wildlife walks (marmots, chamois, ibex). Astronomy sessions.
non_ski_activities.health_resort: Classified health resort since 1981 — thalassotherapy and wellness programmes.
non_ski_activities.events: Winter Opening, torchlight descents, firework displays (31 Dec), Chamallows Party (24 Dec), Halloween workshops, Wolf of Pra Loup mascot hunt, FIS races.
non_ski_activities.food: Fumeton — local cured mutton speciality from Pra-Loup. Savoyard and Provencal cuisine.
non_ski_activities.history: 1975 Tour de France — stage 15 won by Bernard Thévenet. The famous 'Merckx is beaten/Bastille has fallen' sign moment. 1999 Junior World Alpine Ski Championships.
non_ski_activities.other: Ski touring paradise (Ubaye/Mercantour), mountain biking, cycle tourism (Great Alpine Passes), astronomy, snowshoeing, paragliding

honest_drawbacks: Southern Alps — less consistent snow than northern Alps
